newsitem.title: UK: Beckett says UK will veto higher EU social costs.
newsitem.headline: Beckett says UK will veto higher EU social costs.

text.p: Margaret Beckett, trade and industry minister, on Wednesday repeated Britain's intention to veto any moves under the European Union's Social Chapter which would boost social security costs in Britain.
In a speech to businessmen, Beckett said the new government would fulfil its campaign pledge to sign up to the EU's Social Chapter, which the defeated Conservatives opted out of.
But she added: "I know that there have been concerns expressed that the social security costs of the French or the Germans could be transferred to Britain through this means."
"Let me make absolutely clear that if such measures were brought forward, and we believed they would be damaging, we would have no hesitation in using our veto to prevent them," she said
